title: Skyscraper complexes preserve acyclicity and recover the stalk complex
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, let $x\in X$, and let $M^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Define the termwise skyscraper complex $i_{x,*}M^\bullet$ by $(i_{x,*}M^n)(U)=M^n$ when $x\in U$ and $0$ otherwise, with $\mathcal O_X(U)$ acting through the germ at $x$. Then $(i_{x,*}M^\bullet)_x\cong M^\bullet$ as complexes of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules, and if $M^\bullet$ is acyclic [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules], $i_{x,*}M^\bullet$ is acyclic as a complex of sheaves.
